title: Truchas 2D thermal solver
description: Controls for the implicit 2D thermal solver. All three subobjects are required: the linear preconditioner, the correction error norm, and the nonlinear time integrator.

preconditioner.description: Preconditioner for the linearized thermal system.

error-norm.description: Absolute and relative tolerances used to measure temperature and enthalpy corrections.

integrator.description: Nonlinear and BDF time-integration controls used within each thermal time step.

initial-condition.description: Optional controls for the linear face-temperature solve used to construct a consistent initial enthalpy state.

abs-t-tol.description: Absolute temperature correction tolerance. The default is zero. At least one of the absolute or relative temperature tolerances must be positive.

rel-t-tol.description: Relative temperature correction tolerance. The default is zero. At least one of the absolute or relative temperature tolerances must be positive.

abs-h-tol.description: Absolute enthalpy correction tolerance. The default is zero. At least one of the absolute or relative enthalpy tolerances must be positive.

rel-h-tol.description: Relative enthalpy correction tolerance. If omitted, it defaults to rel-t-tol. At least one of the absolute or relative enthalpy tolerances must be positive.

nlk-max-iter.description: Maximum nonlinear Krylov iterations in one nonlinear solve. The default is 5.

nlk-tol.description: Nonlinear Krylov convergence tolerance, relative to the initial nonlinear residual. It must be greater than zero and no greater than one; the default is 0.1.

nlk-max-vec.description: Maximum number of stored nonlinear Krylov vectors. If omitted, it defaults to nlk-max-iter minus one.

nlk-vec-tol.description: Tolerance for accepting a nonlinear Krylov acceleration vector. The default is 0.01.

pc-freq.description: Maximum number of nonlinear iterations between preconditioner recomputations. If omitted, the preconditioner is not limited by an iteration frequency.

use-backward-euler.description: Use backward Euler rather than BDF2 for all time steps. The default is false.

bdf1-startup.description: Use one backward-Euler startup step before beginning BDF2 integration. The default is false.

rel-tol.description: Relative residual tolerance for the initial face-temperature solve. The default is 1e-6.

max-iter.description: Maximum iterations allowed for the initial face-temperature solve. The default is 100.
